plan.hypothesis: Volatility in the first 30 minutes is higher than in the rest of the session.
plan.method: Compute 1-minute log returns per session, then compare the standard deviation of the first 30 minutes with the rest, per day.
plan.significance: A one-sided sign test across days at the 5% level.

question: Is realised volatility higher in the first 30 minutes after the open than later in the session?

open_issues.explanation: Half a year of sessions; the effect is large, but a longer sample would narrow the interval.

summary.author: model
summary.text: Volatility in the first 30 minutes after the open is about 1.8 times the rest of the session on this synthetic dataset.
